mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_application_event_definition (app_id, event_key, label, description, category, is_primary, source_experiment_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entity.appId}, #{entity.eventKey}, #{entity.label}, #{entity.description}, #{entity.category}, #{entity.primary}, #{entity.sourceExperimentId}, #{entity.updatedBy}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), description = VALUES(description), category = VALUES(category), is_primary = VALUES(is_primary), source_experiment_id = VALUES(source_experiment_id), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO pisces_application_metric_definition (app_id, metric_key, name, description, aggregation_type, numerator_event_type, denominator_type, denominator_event_type, is_primary_metric, is_guardrail_metric, source_experiment_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entity.appId}, #{entity.metricKey}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.description}, #{entity.aggregationType}, #{entity.numeratorEventType}, #{entity.denominatorType}, #{entity.denominatorEventType}, #{entity.primaryMetric}, #{entity.guardrailMetric}, #{entity.sourceExperimentId}, #{entity.updatedBy}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), aggregation_type = VALUES(aggregation_type), numerator_event_type = VALUES(numerator_event_type), denominator_type = VALUES(denominator_type), denominator_event_type = VALUES(denominator_event_type), is_primary_metric = VALUES(is_primary_metric), is_guardrail_metric = VALUES(is_guardrail_metric), source_experiment_id = VALUES(source_experiment_id), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_id, event_key, label, description, category, is_primary, source_experiment_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_application_event_definition WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY event_key ASC

SELECT id, app_id, metric_key, name, description, aggregation_type, numerator_event_type, denominator_type, denominator_event_type, is_primary_metric, is_guardrail_metric, source_experiment_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_application_metric_definition WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY metric_key ASC
